next.reason: 1985 GR1: SEARCH ends at END-SEARCH, a separator period, or an ELSE/END-IF of a preceding IF. 2023 states these through the scope rules: END-SEARCH ends 'the most-recently preceding unterminated statement having the statement-name for which that scope terminator is defined' (§2023:14.5.3.2 GR1); END-IF ends 'any unterminated statements that appear between that statement-name and the explicit scope terminator' (§2023:14.5.3.2 GR2); a period ends one 'for a conditional statement not contained within another statement, by a separator period' (§2023:14.5.3.3 GR3); ELSE as the next phrase of the containing IF ends a contained conditional statement (§2023:14.5.3.3 GR4 'for a conditional statement contained within another statement, by'). In 1985 an unterminated SEARCH can be contained only in IF, so the same programs end the same way.
